basic_profile.bio: I am a 20-year-old sophomore majoring in architecture at the University of Florida. I recently switched majors and am eager to explore opportunities to study abroad, especially in Italy. I enjoy gaming, especially playing Among Us and exploring new games like Tiny Rails. I'm originally from Miami, Florida, and I'm currently living in Gainesville. Typically, I'm online in the evenings after class and on weekends. I'm single and focused on my studies right now. I have a keen interest in learning new languages and am currently trying to pick up Italian. I also have a part-time job at the university library, which helps me stay connected with academic resources.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of architecture through my coursework and am actively seeking more information about international opportunities in the field. I also have a casual interest in gaming and language learning, which I primarily explore through online resources and community discussions.
